script_text: Cancer, the Moon — your ruling planet — is about to shake your world this June, and nothing will feel the same. The dominant transit defining your month is Jupiter in Gemini forming a powerful square to your 10th House of career, forcing you to confront ambitions you've been avoiding. In love, Venus in your 7th House of partnerships creates a beautiful trine to your sign, bringing a magnetic connection or deepening an existing bond with someone who truly sees you. Saturn in Pisces continues pressing your 9th House, demanding discipline around finances — a contract or investment decision will define your money story this month. Mars in Leo energizes your 1st House, giving you fierce vitality but watch for burnout. Mark June 12th for a career breakthrough, June 19th for a romantic turning point, and June 27th when Mercury retrograde in your 3rd House could spark miscommunication. Avoid signing any major financial agreements after June 20th. Cancer, subscribe now — the stars are speaking directly to you.
